level1-sync/bash-command/unicode/failure-kb/grep-opt/read-opt/write-edit/agent-persona/
skill-context gates, and the **version-push gate** whose bypass this repo's own history
records fixing) + the warm-daemon fast path (NFR-1). 9 PostToolUse capabilities including
**session progress/checkpoint state** (the NFR-3 finding) and auto-close-issue-on-completion.
policy_tracking_helper's flow-trace recording. Session-identity resolvers (ide_paths,
project_session, session_context) are NOT lost -- confirmed independent importers.
